Name: Helpful Pets - Make your pets help around the farm
Author: CodeKokeshi
Description:
[b]DISCLAIMER: [/b]I've only tested this in VANILLA STARDEW so please don't expect everything to work with OVERHAUL MODS :D

[quote]Working Pets turns your pet into a real helper.[/quote]


[quote][b]Your pet can:[/b]
[list]
[*]Work on the farm (clear debris, chop trees, clear stumps/logs, break boulders)
[*]Do Valley Work (clear debris/targets across the valley)
[*]Follow you around town
[*]Explore independently to forage
[*]Carry items in its own Pet Pouch inventory
[*]Auto-deposit collected items into your chests
[*]Scavenge random items overnight
[/list][/quote]
[center]_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________

[b]Easily assign task to your pets with the new Pet Manager

[/b][img]https://i.imgur.com/zKU8yh4.png[/img]﻿

[b]Easily rename your pets
[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LNdySMl.png[/img]﻿

[b]Easily accessible settings[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0GIeeJm.png[/img]﻿
_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________[/center]

[b]Disclaimer[/b]
Please report bugs in the Posts or Bugs tab with detailed info (what happened, where, which mode was active, and SMAPI log if possible).
I’m still learning Stardew modding, so detailed reports help a lot.

[quote][b]Features
1. Pet Manager (Main UI)[/b]
[list]
[*]Replaces older dialogue-heavy controls.
[*]Quickly set each pet to: Idle, Farm Work, Valley Work, Exploration, or Following.
[*]Rename pets and check status/location in one place.
[/list]
[b]2. Farm Work
[/b][list]
[*]Pets clear targets on the farm based on your settings:
[/list] ﻿ ﻿- Debris (weeds, twigs, stones)
﻿﻿- Trees
﻿﻿- Stumps & Logs
﻿ ﻿- Boulders[list]
[*]Drops go into that pet’s own pouch.
[/list]
[b]3. V[/b][b]alley Work[/b]
[list]
[*]Pets travel and clear configured targets across valley locations.
[*]If no valid work is found, pets return to idle cleanly.
[/list]
[b]4. [/b][b]Follow Mode + Foraging[/b]
[list]
[*]Pets follow you and can forage nearby items while traveling.
[/list]
[b]5. [/b][b]Exploration Mode[/b]
[list]
[*]Pets explore independently and forage through multiple areas.
[/list]
[b]6. Pet Pouch (Per-Pet Inventory)
[/b][list]
[*]Each pet has separate inventory storage.
[/list]
[b]7. [/b][b]Auto Deposit[/b]
[list]
[*]Pets can auto-deposit collected items into matching chests.
[/list]
[b]8. [/b][b]Nightly Scavenge[/b]
[list]
[*]Pets can find random items overnight and place them in their pouch.
[/list]
[b]9. Notification Controls
[/b][list]
[*]Work notifications
[*]State-change notifications
[*]Scavenge notifications
[*]Deposit notifications
[/list][/quote]

[b]Requirements[/b][list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*]SMAPI
[*]StardewUI (required)
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, for easy in-game config)
[/list]
[b]How to use[/b][list=1]
[*]Install and launch with SMAPI.
[*]Open Pet Manager (default hotkey: V).
[*]Select a pet and choose a state.
[*]Adjust behavior/notifications in GMCM (if installed).

[/list][b]Changelogs
[/b]1.5.0
- Fixed stale static pet state persisting across title returns by clearing runtime state on ReturnedToTitle.
- Fixed warp-back logic order at day start so pets can correctly return home before daily flags reset.
- Fixed overnight scavenge using shared/global inventory; scavenge now writes to each pet's own inventory.
- Fixed follow mode being blocked by full inventory checks (follow now works even when inventory is full).
- Fixed forage behavior oscillation/back-and-forth loops with a cooldown after canceling forage.
- Fixed overflow item drops appearing at the wrong pet by tracking inventory owner pet for overflow drops.
- Fixed follow/explore persistence not being saved/loaded reliably between sessions.
- Fixed occasional pet sound crash from null turtle sound cues by hardening sound playback.
- Fixed tapped trees being chopped by pets when tree chopping is enabled (with new tapper-safe logic).
- Fixed inconsistent tree growth-stage checks for chopping/clearing logic.
- Fixed cat-biased purr text being used for non-cat pets in dialogue.
- Added granular notification settings:
    - Show Work Notifications
    - Show State Notifications
    - Show Scavenge Notifications
    - Show Deposit Notifications
- Added missing work-start HUD notifications when work is started from Pet Manager (farm and valley paths).
- Updated all relevant notifications to honor the correct setting toggles.
- Improved Pet Manager UX:
    - Pets now remain idle cleanly when no valid work is found.
    - Larger UI text for better readability.
    - More lively/expressive pet dialogue wording.
    - Active-state tooltips for mode buttons.
    - State-change notifications from menu actions are queued and shown after menu closes.
- Completed localization sweep: removed remaining hardcoded strings and aligned text keys across code/UI.
- Added full Japanese localization support and synchronized translation keys with English.
- Removed deprecated/unused dialogue handlers and cleaned related code paths.
- Stability-focused update for 1.5.0 with major behavior reliability improvements for multi-mode pets.
- Pet Manager state switching is now more consistent and predictable across save/load, sleep, and day transitions.
- Notification system is now fully user-controllable for quieter or more verbose gameplay.


1.4.0
- Exploration system with circular routes (clockwise/counter-clockwise, randomly chosen)
- Pet teleports directly to areas with forageables, pre-scans all areas first
- When area is cleared, pet teleports to next area in route
- Exploration ends when all areas cleared or inventory full, pet returns to farm
- Only one pet can explore at a time, explore option hidden when unavailable
- Pets can be whistled back during exploration (pauses, can resume via dialogue)
- Right-click pet to open command menu (only when stationary, not while walking)
- Each pet now has its own separate inventory (no longer shared)
- Forage quality based on player's foraging level (iridium/gold/silver chances)
- Pet sounds correctly match pet type (dogs bark, cats meow, turtles chirp)
- Only one pet can follow at a time (single follower enforcement)
- Whistle disabled for pets not in same area or when another pet is following
- Pet foraging while following now requires player to forage first
- Pet only forages nearby items (within 5 tiles) when player is within 8 tiles
- Foraging cancels immediately when player moves away or changes location
- All pets reset to idle state at start of each new day
- Auto-deposit matches item quality intelligently: prefers same quality, otherwise chooses highest quality in chest
- Auto-deposit attempts before inventory full error (pets continue working if space freed)
- Sounds only play when player is in same area as pet
- Instant farm scan for work detection (no more slow realization)
- Pet location shown with display name (e.g., "Pierre's General Store" not "SeedShop")
- Pet markers hidden during cutscenes, events, and dialogue
- Inventory size and auto-deposit fully configurable in GMCM
- EXTREME BLINK wall-pass system for obstacle navigation
- Complete follow system rewrite eliminates stuttering and flickering
- State machine: Idle, FollowingPlayer, Foraging, WallPassing
- Smooth velocity-based movement with proper acceleration/deceleration
- Follow distances: stop at 1.25 tiles, start at 2.5 tiles
- Speed scaling based on distance to player
- Various config options for notifications and behavior
- Full i18n support for all text (all hardcoded strings replaced with translation keys)
- Whistle menu can be toggled with same hotkey (open and close)
- Whistle menu supports scrolling for many pets (up/down buttons, mouse wheel, arrow keys, scrollbar drag)
- Whistle menu shows empty state when no pets exist
- "No pets" notification shown once per day when whistle key pressed with no pets available

1.3.1
- Fixed bug where SMAPI console window would flash repeatedly after naming a new pet during the adoption cutscene.
- Pets now use vanilla interaction behavior during events, cutscenes, and when menus/dialogues are active to prevent conflicts.

1.3.0
- Follow mode upgraded from experimental to fully functional
- "Follow Outside Farm" now enabled by default - pets follow everywhere
- Pets forage while following (automatically pick up berries, mushrooms, spring onions, etc.)
- HUD notification when pet picks up forageable item
- "No work to do" notification when no debris/trees/boulders found
- Stuck detection uses ultra-fast speed to bypass obstacles (no teleporting)
- Pets smoothly accelerate through walls when stuck, then slow down
- Message changed from "too far away" to "not on the same area" for clarity
- Added "Forage While Following" config option (enabled by default)
- Fast mode automatically deactivates when pet reaches player
- Whistle keybind system - press V (default, configurable) to open pet menu
- Whistle Key configurable in Generic Mod Config Menu
- Whistle menu shows full-body pet sprites with scrolling for many pets
- Menu shows pet name, status (Idle/Working/Following), disables unavailable pets
- Pet tracking arrows display pet icons (larger scale, center-biased)
- Pets in follow mode are passable (walk through them for doorways)
- Pets exit resting/sleeping when changing locations while following
- Trees at ALL growth stages (0-5) can be removed, including seeds
- Small trees (stages 0-4) use twig effects instead of full tree effects
- Fixed stuck loop counter not accumulating after warps
- Removed "(Experimental)" label from Follow Outside Farm option

1.2.0
- Multi-pet support! Each pet now works independently (Pet Licenses compatible).
- Target reservation system prevents pets from targeting the same debris.
- Collision avoidance keeps pets from stacking on each other.
- Pets now pause and stop moving when you talk to them.
- After 3 failed warp attempts, pets destroy target remotely (fixes infinite stuck loops).
- Trees at all growth stages (1-5) can now be removed, not just fully grown ones.

1.1.0
- Added proper destruction visuals/FX/SFX when pets clear debris/wood/stone (no more silent disappearing).
- Adjusted wood-related destruction to use a consistent twig-style particle/poof effect.
- Fixed cases where pets could get stuck while doing work by adding a warp fallback near the target.
- Improved follow behavior with catch-up speed scaling and a stuck warp fallback near the player.

Downloads.Description:
v1.5.0
- Whistle Menu overhauled into Pet Manager (requires StardewUI)
- Fixed a lot of problems including pet deletion
- Added a lot of features (see changelogs)

Manifest.Name: Working Pets
Manifest.Description: Transform your pets into helpful farmhands! Pet Manager UI to set each pet's mode: Farm Work, Valley Work, Exploration, Follow, or Idle. Features valley-wide debris clearing, tree chopping, autonomous foraging, and smart follow. Press V to open.
Manifest.Author: CodeKokeshi
